description: For hikers who check themselves and their dog after a day in grass and woods: a small stainless steel tick tool with two ends. A fine, angled tweezer tip on one side and a forked notch on the other, so you can pick the end that suits the tick and the spot. It comes in a slim case and weighs about 15 g (0.5 oz), so it lives in a first-aid kit, a pack lid or the glovebox. $12.99 with free shipping. Fingers squeeze and slip, and household tweezers are often too blunt to get close to the skin. A fine angled tip lets you grip the tick right at the skin line and pull it out in one steady move. description: For dog owners who already use an Apple AirTag and want it to stay on the collar: a soft silicone holder that wraps the AirTag and threads onto a flat collar through its two side slots.
